name: Happiness: The Game
source:
''Would you become a God or stay an observer?"

You play as the weirdly ''nameless'' main character, an average 17-years-old high school student going through life as a mere observer, until one day a volleyball club member mysteriously disappears. This sets in motion a chain of events that would forever change his life.

The game deals with themes such as family, pseudo-science and time travel.

[Edited from [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/happiness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你会成为神，还是继续做一名旁观者？”

你将扮演一位名字奇怪地“从未揭晓”的主角。他是一名普通的17岁高中生，平日只是旁观着生活；直到某天，排球社的一名成员神秘失踪，一连串事件由此展开，彻底改变了他的人生。

游戏涉及家庭、伪科学和时间旅行等主题。

[改写自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/happiness]Itch.io[/url]]
